name: Night owl
description: Gets better as the evening goes on. Mornings are a different story.

name: Perfectionist
description: Every plate is a little masterpiece. Every plate also takes a little longer.

name: Sunny
description: Smiles so warmly that customers forget how long they waited.

name: Flaky
description: Lovely when they're here. Sometimes they're just... not.

name: Fast hands
description: Chops, plates and clears at lightning speed.

name: Big appetite for tips
description: Extra charming when there's a tip jar nearby, and expects a fair share of it.

name: Steady Eddie
description: Never rushes, never panics, never drops a plate.

name: Quick learner
description: Watches once, nails it the second time. Grows faster than most.

name: Team player
description: Always the first to help a colleague and the last to grumble.

name: Grumpy but brilliant
description: Mutters at the oven, but the food is wonderful.

name: Chatterbox
description: Customers love a natter. The next table, waiting for their bill, slightly less so.

name: Penny-wise
description: Happy with a modest wage and never wastes a scrap.

name: Ambitious
description: Wants to run their own kitchen one day. Works hard, and will ask for a pay rise.

name: Early bird
description: Fresh as a daisy at lunchtime, yawning by nine.

name: Nervous newbie
description: Gets flustered when it's busy, but improves with a bit of kindness.

name: Showstopper
description: Flambés, flourishes and a little bow. Customers adore it.

name: Tidy as a pin
description: A spotless station and a perfect fridge. Inspectors love them.
